$comment: Example native Claude policy for a policy-controlled Enso workspace. Lives at <policy_dir>/claude/settings.json, chmod 600, OUTSIDE the workspace. Verified against Claude Code 2.1.226 by the security harness: blocks reads of ~/.ssh, ~/.enso, and out-of-workspace paths (incl. via Bash subprocesses), blocks the enso CLI, confines network to api.anthropic.com, and strips secret env vars — while allowing normal work inside the workspace. Tune to your needs; Enso does not grade this file. disableAllHooks is REQUIRED: without it an agent can write .claude/settings.json into its own workspace and have arbitrary commands run outside the sandbox on the next turn (verified). Enso refusing to launch a policy-controlled workspace without it is planned; it is not yet enforced in code. Instructions and skills are discovered by the CLI itself — this file does not curate them; add filesystem deny rules here if you want to keep a workspace away from a particular path.
